source: Instagram reel by @hugomxnning (three screen recordings, 21 Nov 2026), URLs verified by web search the same day

fields.verified: true = URL confirmed from the site itself or several independent sources; false = best lead, confirm before relying on it
fields.agent_access: fastest way for Claude Code to pull from the resource without a browser
fields.cost: free | freemium | paid, with the gated part named

resources.name: 21st.dev
resources.what: Community registry of React + Tailwind (shadcn-style) components: heroes, shaders, backgrounds, pricing, testimonials, AI chat UIs, buttons, cards.
resources.use_when: Need a ready React/Tailwind block for a standard section and want many variants to choose from.
resources.agent_access: CLI: npx @21st-dev/cli add <@author/component>. Each component page also shows a shadcn install command and full TSX source.

resources.name: Originkit
resources.what: Free library of ~180 animated components (text, image gallery, cursor, background, buttons) plus ~48 page sections. Built for Framer first, with React/Next/Vite variants.
resources.use_when: Marketing or landing page needs eye-catching motion (galleries, cursor effects, WebGL backgrounds) without writing the animation yourself.
resources.agent_access: MCP server https://mcp.originkit.dev/mcp (tools: list_components, get_component with stack=nextjs|react|vite|framer, search, fetch). CLI: npx originkit@latest add <component-name>. Do NOT scrape the site: its robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot, so plain fetches return 403.
resources.cautions: Heavy canvas/WebGL/cursor effects with little accessibility or reduced-motion handling. Keep them on marketing pages, never inside app shells or forms.

resources.name: Spell UI
resources.what: Refined, subtle React + Tailwind components for design engineers (light rays, exploding input, perspective book, Spotify card, animated gradient).
resources.use_when: Need one or two restrained 'moments of delight' rather than a full component system.
resources.agent_access: shadcn registry hosted at spell.sh (install with the shadcn CLI; see spell.sh docs for the registry path). Also mirrored on 21st.dev: npx @21st-dev/cli add @spell.

categories.name: Animations
categories.note: Category name inferred: the reel's heading was hidden behind the presenter.

resources.name: Kawai Design: 100 Text Animations
resources.what: Grid of 100 text entrance/emphasis animations (fade, typewriter, shuffle, slide up, scale, blur, neon glow, bounce, 3D flip, jello, wave…) with live text preview and Copy Code buttons.
resources.use_when: Choosing a headline/hero text animation by sight, then copying the code into the project.
resources.agent_access: Browser only: copy the snippet from the card. URL comes from a third-party write-up; confirm it.

resources.name: Kinetics (Colorion)
resources.what: 160+ spring-physics interface animations (buttons, switches, accordions, counters, likes, steppers) with CSS snippets, ~99 React examples and ~150 AI prompts. Includes a CSS spring easing guide and generator.
resources.use_when: A micro-interaction should feel springy or physical and you don't want to add Motion/GSAP. Most entries are pure CSS with cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)-style easing.
resources.agent_access: Each effect page shows the CSS, React and AI prompt. Guide: https://kinetics.colorion.co/guides/css-spring-animation/. Sister site with 123 CSS text effects: https://text-effects.colorion.co
resources.cautions: The source repo is reported to have no LICENSE file. Confirm with the user before shipping its code in a commercial product.

resources.name: Animation Dictionary
resources.what: Searchable library of web effects (Aurora Mesh, Split Text Reveal, Tilt Card 3D…) filtered by trigger (plays on its own / hover / click / scroll) and type (entrance & exit, attention, hover, loading, text, backgrounds, morphing, 3D & space, page transitions), with CSS / HTML / AI tabs.
resources.use_when: Looking up an effect by name or by what triggers it.
resources.agent_access: URL not found. Ask the user for the link. Until then, https://www.whatthefrontend.com/effects/ is a similar named-effects dictionary with AI prompts.

resources.name: Fontshare
resources.what: Free quality fonts from Indian Type Foundry (Satoshi, Clash Display, General Sans, Cabinet Grotesk…), with a free CSS embed API.
resources.use_when: Want a distinctive free typeface that isn't the usual Google Fonts default.
resources.agent_access: CSS embed: https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=<font-slug>@<weights>&display=swap (e.g. f[]=satoshi@400,700). The artifact viewer CSP only allows fonts.googleapis.com, so self-host or use Google Fonts there.
resources.license: ITF Free Font License (free for personal and commercial use)

resources.name: Fonts In Use
resources.what: Independent archive of typography in real-world use, searchable by typeface, format and topic.
resources.use_when: Need pairing ideas or proof that a typeface works in a given industry or tone.
resources.agent_access: Browser/reference only.

resources.name: Fontesk
resources.what: Free font downloads by category (sans, serif, slab, display, script, handwritten) with featured, popular and daily-gift picks.
resources.use_when: Hunting a display or novelty face for a headline.
resources.agent_access: Download files manually and self-host. Check each font's licence because they vary.
resources.cautions: Licences vary per font (some personal use only).

resources.name: Scrolltide
resources.what: Curated library of ~150 scroll-driven website templates, sections, components and GPU shaders, each delivered as a prompt engineered for Claude/Cursor/v0 that outputs Next.js with Framer Motion/GSAP/Three.js/Lenis.
resources.use_when: Want a cinematic scroll-driven hero or landing page that doesn't look AI-made.
resources.agent_access: Copy the prompt from the site and paste it into Claude Code. Free set: https://www.scrolltide.co/free
resources.cost: freemium (8 free templates; paid lifetime access for the full library)

resources.name: GetLayers
resources.what: 'Cinematic AI sites, made easy': prompts for immersive website templates, real-time 3D scenes, interactive sections, animated backgrounds and WebGL gradients.
resources.use_when: Need a 3D scene, shader field or immersive full-site prompt.
resources.agent_access: Copy prompt, paste into Claude Code. Free set available without a card.
resources.cost: freemium (curated free layers; premium prompts need a subscription)

resources.name: MotionSites
resources.what: 'Unlock your AI design superpowers': prompt library for landing pages, hero/feature/pricing/footer sections and animated backgrounds.
resources.use_when: Need a fast, styled landing page or a single section via a prompt.
resources.agent_access: Copy prompt, paste into Claude Code.
resources.cautions: Look-alike domains exist (motionsites.org, mirror sites on vercel.app). Use motionsites.ai.

resources.name: Pinterest
resources.what: Moodboards. Search e.g. 'blue website design' and filter by colour chips.
resources.use_when: Gathering visual direction or a palette from images before choosing exact values.
resources.agent_access: Browser/reference only. Ask the user for boards or screenshots.

resources.name: Coolors
resources.what: Fast colour palette generator plus 10M+ community palettes, contrast checker and gradient tools.
resources.use_when: Turning a vibe into a concrete 5-colour palette with hex values.
resources.agent_access: Palette URLs carry the hex codes, e.g. https://coolors.co/264653-2a9d8f-e9c46a-f4a261-e76f51, so Claude can read or write palettes as URLs.

categories.name: Section and layout inspiration
categories.note: Category name inferred: the reel's heading was hidden behind the presenter.

resources.name: Unsection
resources.what: Section-first inspiration: 5,600+ real website sections browsable by type (hero, testimonials, feature, CTA, footer, blog, navbar, pricing, logo, FAQ, team, contact), industry and style.
resources.use_when: Designing one specific section and want real-world references for it, not whole sites.
resources.agent_access: Browser/reference only.

resources.name: Details.so
resources.what: 'The details behind the world's best websites': 3,500+ hand-tagged references (heroes, footers, scroll animations, page and section transitions, preloaders). Inspo (free browse), Vault (paste-ready code) and an MCP server.
resources.use_when: Need references for a specific interaction or transition, ideally pulled straight into Claude Code.
resources.agent_access: MCP (paid plans): claude mcp add details --scope user --transport http https://api.details.so/mcp, then authenticate via /mcp.
resources.cost: freemium (Vault and MCP need a paid plan)

resources.name: Backgrounds Supply
resources.what: ~2,000 handcrafted gradient, AI-art and animated MP4 backgrounds across 50+ collections. 200+ free picks at /freebies.
resources.use_when: Need a high-quality hero or section backdrop image or looping video.
resources.agent_access: Download manually (free ones need an email sign-in), then add to the project's assets.
resources.cost: freemium (free picks; one-time purchase for the full library)
resources.license: Free picks usable commercially, no attribution required

resources.name: Gradient Lab
resources.what: Free in-browser animated gradient generator from Backgrounds Supply: 20+ live shader modes, exports PNG/JPG/MP4/WebM or embed code.
resources.use_when: Want a custom animated gradient background in brand colours.
resources.agent_access: Browser tool. Export the file or embed code and hand it to Claude Code.
resources.cost: free (up to 1920x1080, no sign-up, no watermark; 4K is Pro)

resources.name: Super Visuals
resources.what: 'Visual Backgrounds Library' of 50+ abstract, 3D and photographic backgrounds (BG 001 Pastel Cloud Island, Midnight Blue Ribbons…), distributed as a Figma community file.
resources.use_when: Need a striking abstract or 3D background and can export from Figma.
resources.agent_access: Export from Figma manually. URL matched by name; confirm it's the same library shown in the reel.

resources.name: Pinterest
resources.what: Moodboards for overall direction.
resources.use_when: Very start of a project, before anything is decided.
resources.agent_access: Browser/reference only.

resources.name: Awwwards
resources.what: Award-winning website showcase (Site of the Day, collections, by category and technology).
resources.use_when: Setting a quality bar or finding ambitious, high-end references.
resources.agent_access: Browser/reference only.

resources.name: Curated
resources.what: ~2,900 real, live websites filed by industry (AI, SaaS, e-commerce, finance, portfolio…) and style. Can assemble real sections into a page brief for a coding agent.
resources.use_when: Need references from a specific industry.
resources.agent_access: Browser. Industry pages at https://curated.design/inspiration/<industry>/
